description: PHP class 'perf_mssql' for performance monitoring and tuning of MSSQL databases, including methods for explaining queries, retrieving table info, and health checks.

classes.name: perf_mssql
classes.description: Class for MSSQL performance monitoring and query analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing with database connection, adjusts SQL syntax for ODBC.

methods.description: Returns the number of current active connections.
